headword: {贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}

definitions.gloss: living in luxury; indulgence; extravagant living
definitions.explanation: A lifestyle of excessive luxury and self-indulgence. Often carries a negative nuance suggesting wastefulness or lack of restraint.

examples.japanese: {贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}な⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They are living a life of luxury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧、{贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: After winning the lottery, they spent their days in extravagant indulgence.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質素|しっそ}→質素：09201_shisso⟧な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: In my younger days I lived extravagantly, but now I lead a simple life.

notes:
USAGE:
The suffix ⟦{三昧|ざんまい}→三昧：05931_zanmai⟧ means "indulging fully in" and attaches to nouns to express doing something to excess. {贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい} specifically refers to living in excessive luxury. Often used with a critical or envious tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (extravagant lifestyle)
- {贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧ (days of indulgence)
- {贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ (to exhaust every luxury)

- ⟦{食|く}い→食う：02657_kuu⟧⟦{三昧|ざんまい}→三昧：05931_zanmai⟧: eating to one's heart's content
